headline: Bank of Japan to keep interest rates unchanged at July meeting - Kyodo
summary: According to people familiar with the matter cited by Kyodo, the Bank of Japan is set to keep interest rates unchanged at its July meeting and raise this year's growth forecast.
why: The Bank of Japan sets the country's short-term policy rate, which influences the yen, Japanese government bond yields and equity valuations.
why_moved: The report says the Bank of Japan is expected to hold rates steady while raising its growth forecast. Markets may reassess the policy path, but the input gives no price figures.
